sections.title: Equipment
sections.note: Swords and shields are one row each; tap the row for the next one.

items.name: Sword
items.notes: The Master Sword gains half its power when either sage is awake, and all of it with both.

tiers.name: Hero's Sword
tiers.howTo: From Orca on Outset Island, after his sword lesson.

tiers.name: Master Sword
tiers.howTo: Draw it in the basement of Hyrule Castle, after the Tower of the Gods.

tiers.name: Master Sword (half power)
tiers.howTo: Wake one sage: Medli in the Earth Temple or Makar in the Wind Temple.

tiers.name: Master Sword (full power)
tiers.howTo: Wake both sages; the sword's power returns in Hyrule Castle.

tiers.name: Hero's Shield
tiers.howTo: From Grandma on Outset Island, before leaving with Tetra's pirates.

tiers.name: Mirror Shield
tiers.howTo: In the Earth Temple's big chest.

items.name: Power Bracelets
items.howTo: Freeze Fire Mountain with an Ice Arrow, climb in through the top and defeat the Magtails before the time runs out.

items.name: Pirate's Charm
items.howTo: Tetra slips it to Link before firing him into the Forsaken Fortress.

items.name: Hero's Charm
items.area: Mrs. Marie's School of Joy, Windfall Island
items.howTo: Give Mrs. Marie 40 Joy Pendants in all: 20 for the Cabana Deed, then 20 more.
items.notes: Shows enemies' health. In Wind Waker HD it's in the chest on floor 50 of the Savage Labyrinth, and the 40 pendants give Treasure Chart 45.

items.name: Telescope
items.howTo: Aryll's birthday present, on her lookout.

items.name: Sail
items.howTo: Buy it from Zunari for 80 Rupees.
items.notes: Wind Waker HD adds the Swift Sail, won at the Windfall Auction; it sails faster and turns the wind for you. It isn't in the GameCube game, so it isn't tracked.

items.name: Wind Waker
items.howTo: The King of Red Lions gives it to Link on arriving at Dragon Roost Island.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.howTo: Medli gives it to Link inside Dragon Roost Cavern.

items.name: Spoils Bag
items.howTo: Pass Niko's rope-swinging test below deck on the way to the Forsaken Fortress.

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: In the Forbidden Woods, after its Mothula.

items.name: Deku Leaf
items.howTo: At the top of the Great Deku Tree, after clearing it of ChuChus.

items.name: Tingle Tuner
items.howTo: Tingle gives it to Link for letting him out of the jail behind Lenzo's house.
items.notes: Needs a Game Boy Advance link cable on the GameCube. Wind Waker HD replaces it with the Tingle Bottle, which sent messages over Miiverse (closed in 2017).

items.name: Picto Box

tiers.name: Picto Box
tiers.howTo: In the chest at the end of the crawlspace maze behind Tingle's jail cell on Windfall Island.

tiers.name: Deluxe Picto Box
tiers.howTo: Bring Lenzo a Forest Firefly (caught in a Bottle in Forest Haven) after his three pictograph tasks.

items.notes: The GameCube box holds 3 pictographs, Wind Waker HD's 12. In HD Lenzo gives the Deluxe Picto Box for the three tasks alone.

items.name: Iron Boots
items.howTo: Thaw Ice Ring Isle with a Fire Arrow and find them in the cave inside.

items.name: Magic Armor
items.howTo: Zunari gives it to Link partway through the Traveling Merchants' trading chain.
items.notes: Drains magic on the GameCube; in Wind Waker HD it costs Rupees when Link is hit.

items.name: Bait Bag
items.howTo: Buy it from Beedle for 20 Rupees.

tiers.name: Hero's Bow
tiers.howTo: In the Tower of the Gods, after its Darknut.

tiers.name: Fire & Ice Arrows
tiers.howTo: From the Queen of Fairies on Mother and Child Isles; warp there with the Ballad of Gales.

tiers.name: Light Arrows
tiers.howTo: In Ganon's Tower, at the end of Phantom Ganon's maze.

items.name: Bombs
items.howTo: Sneak aboard Tetra's ship at Windfall and pass Niko's second test.

items.name: Delivery Bag
items.howTo: Quill gives it to Link on Dragon Roost Island.

items.name: Hookshot
items.howTo: In the Wind Temple, after its Wizzrobe.

items.name: Skull Hammer
items.howTo: On the second visit, after Phantom Ganon's ambush.

items.name: Bottle (Medli)
items.howTo: Medli gives it to Link after he helps her up the mountain to Dragon Roost Cavern.

items.name: Bottle (Mila)
items.howTo: At night, follow Mila from the potion shop without being seen and catch her at Zunari's safe.
items.after: After the second visit to the Forsaken Fortress

items.name: Bottle (Bomb Island submarine)
items.howTo: Defeat the Bokoblins in the submarine near Bomb Island to make the chest appear.

items.name: Bottle (Beedle's special shop)
items.howTo: Buy it for 500 Rupees at the masked Beedle's shop ship by Rock Spire Isle.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says it's on sale once you have Beedle's Chart (sent by post after you get the Bombs).

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.note: Great Fairies give the wallet, bomb and quiver upgrades and double magic (see Great Fairies).

items.name: Wallet
items.notes: Either fairy can be first: the first one visited gives 1,000 and the second 5,000. Wind Waker HD's wallet starts at 500.

tiers.name: 1,000 Rupees
tiers.howTo: A Great Fairy: Outset Island's Forest of Fairies (bomb the rock) or Northern Fairy Island.

tiers.name: 5,000 Rupees
tiers.howTo: The other of those two Great Fairies.

items.name: Bomb Bag
items.notes: Either fairy can be first; the second gives 99.

tiers.name: 60 Bombs
tiers.howTo: A Great Fairy: Southern Fairy Island (break the wooden wall) or Eastern Fairy Island (bomb the rock).

tiers.name: 99 Bombs
tiers.howTo: The other of those two Great Fairies.

items.name: Quiver
items.notes: Either fairy can be first; the second gives 99.

tiers.name: 60 Arrows
tiers.howTo: A Great Fairy: Western Fairy Island or Thorned Fairy Island; pound the stakes by each with the Skull Hammer.

tiers.name: 99 Arrows
tiers.howTo: The other of those two Great Fairies.

tiers.name: Magic Meter
tiers.howTo: With the Deku Leaf, from the Great Deku Tree.

tiers.name: Double magic
tiers.howTo: From the Great Fairy freed by defeating the four-eyed Big Octo at Two-Eye Reef.

items.name: Hurricane Spin
items.howTo: Bring Orca 10 Knight's Crests, dropped by Darknuts; he teaches the Hurricane Spin.
items.notes: Orca's letter about the crests arrives once Link has the Bombs.
